'''Lurr''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Rayter sector/Legends|Rayter sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> One of the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] that [[Mission to Cheelit|accompanied]] the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to [[Cheelit/Legends|Cheelit]] killed a young woman while on the planet. The [[Guild of Vindicators]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Clat]] the Shamer later used the memories of that event to compel the soldier to commit suicide.<ref name="DLC">{{StoryCite|story=Dark Lord's Conscience|book=The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 155}}</ref>
